name: Muslim Public Affairs Council Foundation
mission: MPAC improves public understanding and policies that impact American Muslims by engaging our government, media, and communities.
theoryOfChange: The Muslim Public Affairs Council (MPAC) has a 'flagship policy framework' called 'Human Security Now'. This framework 'centers the impact of policy decisions on everyday people' and 'encourages policymakers to prioritize these four freedoms in all policy considerations, enabling a comprehensive and scalable analysis of every potential policy decision'. The four freedoms are Freedom from Fear, Freedom from Want, Freedom of Expression, and Freedom of Worship.

rich_narrative.summary: The Muslim Public Affairs Council Foundation (MPAC) is a Los Angeles-based advocacy organization that works to <cite id="1">shape American policies and public opinion</cite> through government and media engagement. The organization focuses on systemic change by <cite id="4">increasing public understanding of American Muslims</cite> and influencing policies that impact the community. In FY2024, the foundation reported <cite id="3">total revenue of $4,252,481</cite>, representing a period of significant financial growth with a <cite id="3">3-year revenue CAGR of 41.7%</cite>. MPAC operates several specialized initiatives, including the <cite id="4">Center for Government Affairs and the Hollywood Bureau</cite>, which works to improve Muslim representation in entertainment. While the organization maintains <cite id="1">strong financial stability with 21.4 months of working capital</cite>, its program expense ratio remains a point of balance. In FY2024, the <cite id="1">program expense ratio was 57.2%</cite>, though some filings indicate a <cite id="1">program ratio as low as 57%</cite> depending on the accounting of certain advocacy costs. This reflects the resource-intensive nature of policy work, which often requires significant administrative and fundraising support to maintain <cite id="1">high fundraising efficiency of $0.15 per $1 raised</cite>. The foundation provides <cite id="11">clear evidence of its program work</cite> through the publication of <cite id="7">policy papers, community guides, and educational toolkits</cite>.
